page_thesis: The 2026 FIFA World Cup opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca, marking the first 48-team tournament across Mexico, USA, and Canada. This page covers qualified teams, match schedules, venues, and tournament format ahead of kickoff.
confidence_summary: Excellent evidence from official FIFA sources confirms tournament structure, opening date/venue, and tri-nation hosting. Qualification information still developing as of May 2026.
